objective: Implement BUKLOD Government in existing Focus Apps as an isolated DEV-only verified agency and free citizen community service; no production modification or OTA publication.
productionBaselineEvidence: Genesis integration baseline SHA cf99bd23d5e0eea0e56d0921c5b8079f4aeda27c inspected on Nov 20, 2026. Main production environment and actual Android runtime not independently verified, so no production release, no database schema mutation and no OTA claimed.
chosenApproach: Reuse profile Focus Apps government/local route and shared Supabase authentication/Wall validation; add verified entities, permissions, case workflows and mandatory RLS through isolated add-only migration. Keep municipal/local official feed in Government portal pending separate shared Public Wall scope identity review.
selectionRationale: No new bottom navigation or duplicate social engine is needed. A dedicated government data-security boundary prevents impersonation, public exposure of complaints and unmanaged scope widening.
alternativeApproaches: Use arbitrary existing organization scope roles for government authority (rejected: organization role does not prove government authorization)
Publish every government locality post nationally by inserting public posts directly (rejected: breaks geographic scope and canonical moderation)
Deploy to live Supabase immediately without local database RLS tests (rejected: high-risk privacy/regression exposure)
